note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Twelve divisions received a single nomination each and were returned unopposed, so there was no poll; the retiring councillors in the remaining divisions continued in office. Filed on the rural districts' polling day, Thursday 2 June 1927 (queue nominal 26 May). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
